name: Extended Multiple Importance Sampling
definition: A framework to combine estimators of integrals on spaces of different dimensions (e.g., regular path integrals vs. extended space integrals with blurring kernels) by extending the MIS framework to accept estimators of integrals on spaces of different dimension and devising a corresponding balance heuristic.
summary: Extended Multiple Importance Sampling combines estimators from different dimensional spaces, solving variance reduction in volumetric path tracing by accounting for kernel support integrals.
